channel.title: One Fruit a Week: The Fruit of the Spirit
channel.description:
Nine short episodes, one for each fruit of the Spirit in Galatians 5:22-23. Each one reads the verse from the World English Bible (public domain), explains the fruit in plain words, and gives one small thing to practise this week. Good for families, youth groups and personal devotions.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Ninefruit: Fruit of the Spirit, an iPhone app that turns Galatians 5:22-23 into small, practical daily steps. Ninefruit: Fruit of the Spirit on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
